notes: Portable C++ primary/contract and Java parity translate the independently green native 130-assertion four-member HLA_EVOKED mixed-TSO save/restore case. A named object carries a timestamp-7 update and timestamp-8 deletion while a second sender issues a timestamp-7 interaction; both recipients are time constrained. The four-member save captures queued messages and retraction ledgers. Pre-restore retractions terminalize the three designators. After restore, each recipient's Flush Queue Request releases its own saved callbacks before its grant; the three designators again produce public Request Retraction callbacks and terminal errors. The adapter supplies the installed provider, endpoint, IEEE 1516.2-2025 FOM with object/attribute and interaction/parameter, logical-time implementation, and HLA_EVOKED callback configuration. Both portable languages explicitly select TIMESTAMP order through standard services because a conforming FOM may default to RECEIVE. Twenty-four direct requirement-section pairs cover eighteen clauses. Isolated portable C++ primary/contract passed against an installed package using HLAinteger64Time and HLAfloat64Time. Java compiles against the official API-only JAR; Java provider runtime and HLA_IMMEDIATE are unverified. No interoperability, general temporal-persistence, or conformance claim.
